# TeamTango

> TeamTango is an all-in-one team engagement and culture platform for remote, hybrid, and in-office teams: a team wall for highlights and kudos, automated birthday and work anniversary celebrations, PTO and time-off management with approvals, events, gift funds, anonymous team pulse check-ins, engagement insights, and a people directory. Currently in development — a public waitlist is open at https://teamtango.io.

## What TeamTango does

- **Team Wall & Smart Posts**: a social feed where teams share highlights, kudos, and challenges. Posts are auto-categorized by AI and support @mentions.
- **Recognition & Reactions**: peer-to-peer kudos with @mentions and emoji reactions (love, like, dislike, sad, funny) and threaded comments to make appreciation visible and persistent.
- **Automated Celebrations**: once an admin switches them on, birthdays, work anniversaries, and new joiners are announced to the team automatically, and a weekly digest email recaps the wall.
- **PTO Management**: time-off requests with manager approval, leave balances per leave type, half-day support, public-holiday awareness per country/region, and a team availability calendar.
- **Team Insights**: engagement analytics — kudos sent, posts created, engagements, participation rate — with week-over-week trends.
- **Org Management**: departments, teams, and a searchable people directory.
- **Events & Gift Funds**: team events with RSVPs, and gift funds for birthdays and farewells, kept hidden from the person they're for.
- **Team Pulse**: rotating anonymous check-in questions; no breakdown is shown until at least three people have answered.
- **Notifications & Integrations**: live in-app notifications, email for important events, and posts into Slack, Microsoft Teams, or Mattermost channels, plus signed webhooks for anything else.

## Who it is for

Remote, hybrid, and in-office teams that care about culture, from startups to mid-size companies. Team leads keep recognition visible; HR / people-ops manage time off and read engagement signals; everyone uses the wall to stay connected.

## How it compares

TeamTango complements chat tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams) rather than replacing them. Chat is ephemeral — recognition scrolls away within hours. TeamTango is a persistent culture layer where kudos, celebrations, and milestones stay visible, and where time off and engagement are managed properly.

## Status and access

- Status: in development, launching soon
- Access: join the waitlist at https://teamtango.io (email only)
- Pricing: announced at launch; waitlist members get early access first
